# Emily Adams

> Managing Partner, Board Member and Speaker based in the Greater Tampa Bay Area, Florida. 15 years across manufacturing, tech and supply chain, bridging the gap for people, processes and technology. Website: https://emilyadams.speakerfolio.com/

## Current roles
- Managing Partner, HyLo Inno (May 2026 to present): a hyperlocal innovation investment firm that tracks the gaps in Tampa Bay's manufacturing, healthcare and entrepreneurship sectors. Runs Manufacturing Day and HyLo Inno Circles, closed peer groups for CIO, CHRO, CFO and COO leaders.
- Operating Partner, Gulf Works Lab (May 2026 to present): Innovation-as-a-Service, a skunkworks lab for hire for EBITDA-positive companies with $50M to $1B revenue. Delivers working prototypes and redesigned processes in 2 to 3 week sprints.
- Chief Operating Officer, Tampa Bay Tech Week (February 2026 to present).
- Fractional COO for growth-stage companies.

## Past roles and results
- Finance Operations Manager, ConnectWise (2021 to 2026): saved $6M+ in credits and lost revenue, including $2.5M recovered in the first six months; ran global quote-to-cash for 30+ third-party vendors; led two teams, one global.
- Founder, Leading With Human Design (2022 to 2026): helped companies simplify operations and develop effective leaders.
- Cross Functional Lead, Honda Manufacturing of Indiana (2016 to 2020): led workforce strategy for a 2,500-person operation; $1.5M saved through manpower and process audits; $2M break area project delivered a month early and under budget; 15% fewer payroll errors; 7% lower attrition.
- Project Manager, Valeo (2007 to 2015): $250,000 saved a year by cutting scrap 5% with root cause analysis and PDCA.

## Education
- Purdue University, Bachelor of Science in Organizational Leadership.

## Speaking topics
- Find what's broken, build what's missing: the operational and workforce foundation that lets organizations innovate.
- Bridging people, process and technology: adopting AI and modernizing operations, where adoption is the deliverable.
- Before the big operational decision: tracing lost revenue to broken processes, root cause analysis and PDCA.
- Video: How To Shift Your Energy As a Leader, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=T0jUGEXOviE

## Expertise
Quote-to-Cash, Financial Operations, Organizational Change Management, Business Operations, Manufacturing Production Lines, Cost Savings, Efficiency Improvements, Problem Solving, Root Cause Analysis, PDCA, Leadership Development and Training.
